# @amykit/plugin-command-gate

A gate that runs the target repository's own commands.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `gate` port.

Use it with ticket-to-qa, which needs a gate port to decide whether a change is ready for review. It runs the target repository's own commands, listed per repository with a default fallback, and refuses a repository that has neither. With file-worktree mounted, the commands run in the work item's own checkout.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `gate` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-command-gate
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-command-gate"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-command-gate":
    baseBranch: {}
    defaultBranch: "main"
    gate: {}
    timeoutMs: 1800000
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `baseBranch` | `record` | no | `{}` | where one repository's base branch is, instead of the fallback. A repository named here has its work cut from, and its pull requests opened against, that branch |
| `defaultBranch` | `string` | no | `main` | the branch new work is cut from, for a repository that named none, which is not always `main` |
| `gate` | `record` | no | `{}` | the deterministic gate commands per repository, with a `default` fallback; a repository with no entry and no `default` is refused rather than waved through |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | no | `1800000` | how long one check may run before it is given up on |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
